selectionEntries.name: Additional Copy Costs

modifiers.value: Additional Copy Costs is automatically managed by the listbuilder and should appear only once. Remove any extra Additional Copy Costs entries.

selectionEntries.comment:
SOFT OTHER COPY COSTS. Permanent required accounting entry. Aggregates +20 Points per copy of every native non-Rare Other unit beyond the selected Game Size's 1/2/3 normal allowance.
CONFIGURATION VALIDATION: Game System revision 11 handles a missing Additional Copy Costs entry through Army > Configuration. This entry carries the hidden required-configuration category and self-reports duplicates. Existing copy-cost arithmetic is unchanged.

selectionEntries.name: Vexilla

rules.name: Teleport Beacon
rules.description: While this unit is in the battlefield, each time you use the Teleport Homer ability for any of your other units, you may instead use ‘teleport beacon’. If you do, Deploy that unit wholly within 2D6+2” of and visible to this unit. Then, during this turn's Move step, do not make a Move Roll and this unit cannot Advance or Reposition.

selectionEntries.comment: Complete replacement loadout. This represents replacing Guardian Weapon Bolter + Guardian Weapon with Vexilla and gaining Teleport Beacon.

rules.description: After this unit is targeted by one or more ranged attacks, you may roll a D6. On a 3+, until the end of the battle round, for each ranged attack that targets this unit, the Hit Roll for that attack is worsened by 1, and you cannot roll for this ability until the next battle round.

catalogue.comment:
PHASE 0.1 ADEPTUS CUSTODES. All 12 native datasheets are fixed one-model selections. The three Shield-Captains are counted Rare Leaders, cannot attach, and share one explicit army-wide SHIELD-CAPTAIN max-1 restriction. Redundant individual Rare max constraints are omitted so New Recruit shows the mutual-exclusion counter plus Leader-cap counter only. Left Hand of the Emperor is an optional unchecked Configuration placeholder for a future Sisters of Silence reusable library.

COMPLETE LOADOUT + ADDITIONAL COPY COST PASS
All 12 native Adeptus Custodes datasheets now expose their simple loadouts and paid wargear. Arae-Shrike and other ability-only paid options include their player-facing rules. Left Hand of the Emperor remains a Sisters of Silence placeholder. All native non-Rare Other units use the soft 1/2/3 Additional Copy Cost system.

CONSTRUCTIVE ERROR MIGRATION
Adeptus Custodes now use Game System revision 11. Additional Copy Costs uses the current Configuration safeguard, and the shared SHIELD-CAPTAIN army limit uses constructive player-facing validation. The three Shield-Captains remain Rare, count toward Leader Capacity, cannot attach, and deliberately do not receive redundant individual Rare limits. Left Hand of the Emperor remains an untouched Phase 0.1 Sisters of Silence placeholder. Existing loadouts, points, and Additional Copy Costs arithmetic are otherwise unchanged.
